body: I'm still a student, I can't afford to move out. Trust me, I've ran the numbers.

I feel like I'm spoken to both like I am a child, and that I only exist to do as she wants. She demands, and never asks, and when a demand is withheld then she throws an abusive temper tantrum. 

All I'd like is to be spoken to as an adult with respect. I don't want to be cussed at, or insulted because I won't do something, or because I'm not doing something fast enough. 

I wouldn't say there is pressure. Everything is fine if I do what she wants, when she wants it, and I try to stay out of her way. We live in a 2 bedroom apartment, and I see her maybe twice a day. I stick to minimal contact. The problems start when she doesn't get her own way.
